title: Plateau State Government Shuts Down Schools Over Diphtheria Outbreak
desc: The Plateau State government has ordered the temporary closure of all public and private primary and secondary schools over outbreak of diphtheria. The state government in a release on Saturday said the decision was meant to prevent the students from being infected by the disease.

title: Activation of community first responders did not improve short-term survival after cardiac arrest
desc: Community first responders did not improve 30-day survival in patients with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, according to results presented in a Hot Line session today at ESC Congress 2026.

title: Middle-East Conflict: US Strikes Three Iranian Oil Tankers As Iran Targets American Warships
desc: The United States military has announced it struck and disabled three Iranian crude oil carriers, claiming Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) launched ballistic missiles at two US Navy warships in regional waters, further escalating the months-long conflict between Washington and Tehran.
